name: Pandora
source:
Earth Age: 19 years old.
Special Trait: Bob cut & the animal called Pearl on his shoulder
Element: Water
Abilities: Hypnosis, Can support other people to strengthen their skills

An intellectual tactician.
An obstinate and prideful person, but he's kind at heart.
In order to gain favor from god it seems he's lost sight of his true self however.

(Only capturable with the male protagonist)
